40009307.author: पदार्थः
40009307.content: ततः then, अहम् I, क्रोधसमाविष्टम्  overpowered with anger, सम्रब्धम् agitated, उपागतम्  arrived, तं भ्रातरम् brother, प्रियकाम्यया to pacify, प्रसादयाञ्चक्रे I appeased.

40009307.author: Translation
40009307.content: 'I sought to appease my brother who arrived in an agitated state overpowered with anger.

40009308.author: पदार्थः
40009308.content: अनाथनन्दन  compassionate to orphans, दिष्ट्या providence, त्वया by you, रिपुः enemy, निहतः is killed, कुशली safely, प्राप्तः असि have returned, अनाथस्य  to the orphan, मे  me, त्वम् you, एकः alone, नाथः are the saviour.

40009308.author: Translation
40009308.content: 'By providence you have come back safe and the enemy has been killed. You are the only protector to an orphan which I am.

40009309.author: पदार्थः
40009309.content: ते to you, मया by me, धृतम् held, बहुशलाकम् having many ribs, उदितम् risen above, पूर्णचन्द्रमिव like the full Moon, सवालव्यजनम् Yak tailfans, इदम् this, छत्रम् parasol, प्रतीच्छस्व pray accept.

40009309.author: Translation
40009309.content: 'Here is the manyribbed parasol shining like the full Moon above the horizon and the yak's tailfan held by me.Pray accept it.

40009310.author: पदार्थः
40009310.content: नृप O king, आर्तः distressed, संवत्सरम् one year, बिलद्वारि at the entrance of the cave, स्थितः waited, अथ and then, बिलात् from the cave, समुत्थितम् flowing out, शोणितम् blood, द्वारि at the entrance, दृष्ट्वा च and seeing, शोकसंविग्नह्रुदयः with a sunken heart, भृशम् greatly, व्याकुलितेन्द्रियः senses fused, तदा then, तत् that, बिलद्वारम् entrance of the cave, शैलशृङ्गेण with a rock, अपिधाय closed, तस्मात् from  that place, देशात् kingdom, अपक्रम्य retreated, पुनः again, किष्किन्धाम् to Kishkinda, प्राविशम् entered.

40009310.author: Translation
40009310.content: 'O king I waited at the entrance of the cave for a year. As you did not come out, I felt distressed and my heart sank in great sorrow seeing blood flowing out of the cave. With my senses fused I returned to Kishkinda, closing the entrance with a rock(lest the demon should come out).

40009311.author: पदार्थः
40009311.content: नृप O king, आर्तः distressed, संवत्सरम् one year, बिलद्वारि at the entrance of the cave, स्थितः waited, अथ and then, बिलात् from the cave, समुत्थितम् flowing out, शोणितम् blood, द्वारि at the entrance, दृष्ट्वा च and seeing, शोकसंविग्नह्रुदयः with a sunken heart, भृशम् greatly, व्याकुलितेन्द्रियः senses fused, तदा then, तत् that, बिलद्वारम् entrance of the cave, शैलशृङ्गेण with a rock, अपिधाय closed, तस्मात् from  that place, देशात् kingdom, अपक्रम्य retreated, पुनः again, किष्किन्धाम् to Kishkinda, प्राविशम् entered.

40009311.author: Translation
40009311.content: 'O king I waited at the entrance of the cave for a year. As you did not come out, I felt distressed and my heart sank in great sorrow seeing blood flowing out of the cave. With my senses fused I returned to Kishkinda, closing the entrance with a rock(lest the demon should come out).

40009312.author: पदार्थः
40009312.content: विषादात् due to grief, इह here, माम् me, दृष्ट्वा  seeing, पौरैः by the people, मन्त्रिभिरेव च and by the ministers also, अभिषिक्तः  consecrated, कामेन by desire, न not, त्वम् you, मे my, तत् that, क्षन्तुम् to excuse, अर्हसि ought to.

40009312.author: Translation
40009312.content: 'Here I was consecrated by the people and ministers who saw me immersed in grief. It was not my desire to be coronated. Therefore, I may be forgiven.

40009313.author: पदार्थः
40009313.content: मानार्हः worthy of reverence, राजा the king, त्वमेव you alone are, अहं च I also, पुरा यथा like  in earlier times, मम to me, अयम् this, राजभावे held the state, नियोगः an assignment, त्वद्विरहात् due to your absence, कृतः held, सामात्यपौरनगरम् with ministers, citizens and towns, निहतकण्टकम् with the enemies destroyed, स्थितम् is stable.

40009313.author: Translation
40009313.content: 'You alone are the king and worthy of reverence.I will be the same old brother carrying out my work as earlier. I held the responsibility of the state in your absence forced by the citizens and ministers. The kingdom has been kept stable with the enemies destroyed.

40009314.author: पदार्थः
40009314.content: मानार्हः worthy of reverence, राजा the king, त्वमेव you alone are, अहं च I also, पुरा यथा like  in earlier times, मम to me, अयम् this, राजभावे held the state, नियोगः an assignment, त्वद्विरहात् due to your absence, कृतः held, सामात्यपौरनगरम् with ministers, citizens and towns, निहतकण्टकम् with the enemies destroyed, स्थितम् is stable.

40009314.author: Translation
40009314.content: 'You alone are the king and worthy of reverence.I will be the same old brother carrying out my work as earlier. I held the responsibility of the state in your absence forced by the citizens and ministers. The kingdom has been kept stable with the enemies destroyed.

40009315.author: पदार्थः
40009315.content: न्यासभूतम् was in trust, इदं राज्यम् this kingdom, अहम् I am, तव to you, निर्यातयामि I am returning, शत्रुनिबर्हण a slayer of enemies, सौम्य goodnatured, मम at me, रोषम् anger, मा कृथाः to give up

40009315.author: Translation
40009315.content: 'I am handing over this kingdom which was in trust. O slayer of enemies, O good natured one, give up your anger against me.

40009316.author: पदार्थः
40009316.content: राजन् O king, शिरसा head bent, त्वाम् you, याचे I beg you, मया by myself, अयम् this, अञ्जलिः folded palms, बद्धः bound, मन्त्रिभिः by ministers, पुरवासिभिः by citizens, समागम्य having assembled, अहम् I, शून्यदेशजिगीषया kingdom without a king can be conquered, अस्मिन् in this, राजभावे as king, बलात् with pressure, नियुक्तः assigned.

40009316.author: Translation
40009316.content: 'O king I bow my head and beg you with folded hands. The ministers and citizens assembled and forced me to take charge, as the kingdom without a ruler was vulnerable to attack.'

40009317.author: पदार्थः
40009317.content: सः वानरः that monkey, एवम् thus, स्निग्धम् affectionately, ब्रुवाणम् speaking, माम् me, निर्भर्त्स्य having abused, त्वाम् you are, धिक् reproached, इति च this way, उक्त्वा after saying, तत्तत् in various ways, बहु many (words), उवाच ह spoke

40009317.author: Translation
40009317.content: 'Even tnough I spoke to him with affection, Vali abused me in many words, saying, 'Fie on you'.

40009318.author: पदार्थः
40009318.content: प्रकृतीश्चैव ordinary people, सम्मतान् whom he liked, मन्त्रिण श्चैव and ministers, समानीय having invited, सुहृदाम् of friends, मध्ये in the midst, माम् me, परमगर्हितम् contemptuous, वाक्यम् words, आह he spoke

40009318.author: Translation
40009318.content: 'Having invited ordinary people and favourite ministers he condemned me in the presence of friends.

40009319.author: पदार्थः
40009319.content: सुदुर्मतिः wickedminded one, महासुरः great demon, मायावी Mayavi, क्रुद्धः angry one, युद्धाकाङ्क्षी wishing to tight, यथा as, रात्रौ In that night, माम् me, समाह्वयत challenged, वः to you, विदितं is known.

40009319.author: Translation
40009319.content: 'You know very well how that wicked demon, Mayabi, that night challenged me angrily to a duel.

40009320.author: पदार्थः
40009320.content: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनम् words , श्रुत्वा after hearing, अहम् I, नृपालयात् from the royal abode, निःसृतः I came out, सुदारुणः terrific, अयम् this, भ्राता brother, तूर्णम् quickly, माम् me, अनुयातः followed.

40009320.author: Translation
40009320.content: 'On hearing his words I came out of the royal abode quickly, followed by this wicked brother.

40009321.author: पदार्थः
40009321.content: महाबलः powerful, सः he, रात्रौ that night, सद्वितीयम् followed by a second person, माम् me, दृष्ट्वा एव soon after seeing that, प्राद्रवत् he ran, समुपागतौ both advancing towards him, आवाम् both of us, वीक्ष्य after seeing, भयसन्त्रस्तः shaken with fear, वेगेन speedily, प्रविवेश entered, सः he, महाबिलम् huge cave, अनुद्रुत was chased.

40009321.author: Translation
40009321.content: 'The powerful demon that night saw me followed by another advancing towards him and fled out of fear. When we chased him, he entered this huge cave in great speed.

40009322.author: पदार्थः
40009322.content: महाबलः powerful, सः he, रात्रौ that night, सद्वितीयम् followed by a second person, माम् me, दृष्ट्वा एव soon after seeing that, प्राद्रवत् he ran, समुपागतौ both advancing towards him, आवाम् both of us, वीक्ष्य after seeing, भयसन्त्रस्तः shaken with fear, वेगेन speedily, प्रविवेश entered, सः he, महाबिलम् huge cave, अनुद्रुत was chased.

40009322.author: Translation
40009322.content: 'The powerful demon that night saw me followed by another advancing towards him and fled out of fear. When we chased him, he entered this huge cave in great speed.

40009323.author: पदार्थः
40009323.content: सुघोरम् dreadful, तम् him, सुमहत् great, बिलम् hole, प्रविष्टम् entering, विदित्वा knowing, अथ thereafter, क्रूरदर्शनः with cruel looks, अयम् this, मम भ्राता my brother, मया by me, उक्तः has been told.

40009323.author: Translation
40009323.content: 'When I saw the dreadful demon entering the great cave, I instructed this cruel brother of mine:

40009324.author: पदार्थः
40009324.content: अहत्वा without killing him, इतः from this place, पुरीम् town, प्रतिगन्तुम् to return, मे to me, शक्तिः energy, नास्ति is not, अहम् I, एनम् him, यावत् till that time, हन्मि I kill and return, त्वम् you, बिलद्वारि at the entrance, प्रतीक्ष you may wait.

40009324.author: Translation
40009324.content: 'I cannot return from here without killing him. Wait at the entrance of the cave until I kill him. Look forward to my return.

40009325.author: पदार्थः
40009325.content: अयम् this, स्थितः इति waiting there, मत्वा तु thinking like that, अहम् I, दुरासदम् formidable, प्रविष्टः entered, तदा then, तत्र there, तम् him, मार्गमाणस्य in the process of searching, मे for me, संवत्सरः गतः one year was over.

40009325.author: Translation
40009325.content: 'Presuming that Sugriva was waiting there, I entered the formidable cave. While I was searching for the demon there, one year passed.

40009326.author: पदार्थः
40009326.content: भयावहः fearful one, सः he, शत्रुः enemy, मया by me, अनिर्वेदात् without any difficulty, दृष्टः was seen, बन्धुभिः सह along with his relatives, तत्र there, मया by me, निहतः killed, च असुरः that demon.

40009326.author: Translation
40009326.content: 'I could find that fearful enemy there and killed him along with his relatives without any difficulty.

40009327.author: पदार्थः
40009327.content: भूतले on the ground, स्तनतः was roaring, तस्य his, आस्यात् from his mouth, प्रवृत्तेन due to emergence, रुधिरौघेण by the flow of blood, तत् बिलम् that cavern, पूर्णम् full, दुराक्रामम् आसीत् difficult to stay.

40009327.author: Translation
40009327.content: That cavern became difficult to bear, filled on the ground with the flood of blood pouring from his mouth as he roared.

40009328.author: पदार्थः
40009328.content: दुन्दुभेः Dundubhi's, सुतम् son, विक्रान्तम् valiant, तं शत्रुम् that enemy, सूदयित्वा after vanquishing, इह here, निष्क्रामम् as I returned, पश्यामि I could find, बिलस्य cavern, मुखम् entrance, पिहितम् was closed.

40009328.author: Translation
40009328.content: After vanquishing that valiant enemy, the son of Dundubhi, as I came out I found the mouth of the cave closed.

40009329.author: पदार्थः
40009329.content: सुग्रीवेति saying O Sugriva , पुनः पुनः again and again, विक्रोशमानस्य  shouting in distress, मे for me, यदा when, प्रतिवचः response, नास्ति was not heard, ततः then, अहम् I, भृशदुःखितः  very sad.

40009329.author: Translation
40009329.content: 'When there was no response from Sugriva to my repeated call in distress I was very sad.

40009330.author: पदार्थः
40009330.content: मया by me, बहुभिः by many, पादप्रहारैः kicks, विदारितम् broken, ततः then, अहम् I, तेन by that, यथा as, निष्क्रम्य after coming out, पुरः to city, उपागतः arrived.

40009330.author: Translation
40009330.content: 'I kicked the boulder again and again till it yielded. I came out that way and arrived at the city.

40009331.author: पदार्थः
40009331.content: आत्मनः my own, राज्यम् kingdom, प्रार्थयता by desiring, सुग्रीवेण by Sugriva, नृशंसेन by the wicked one, अनेन by him, भ्रातृसौहृदम् brotherly love, विस्मृत्य forgetting, अहम् I, तत्र there, अस्मि I am, संरुध्दः I was obstructed

40009331.author: Translation
40009331.content: 'I was obstructed by wicked Sugriva who forgot his brotherly love and was desiring  the kingdom, which belongs to me.'

40009332.author: पदार्थः
40009332.content: वानरः monkey, वाली Vali, तत्र there, माम् me, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, विगतसाध्वसः unperturbed, तदा then, एकेन with a single, वस्त्रेण cloth, निर्वासयामास   banished me.

40009332.author: Translation
40009332.content: 'When Vali, the monkey, spoke that way I remained unperturbed. He banished me  with the only cloth I was wearing.

40009333.author: पदार्थः
40009333.content: राघव O Rama, तेन on account of that, अपविद्धः attacked, हृतदारश्च stolen of my wife, अहम् I am, तद्भयात् by that fear, सवनार्णवा the entire forest and oceans, कृत्स्ना completely, इयं मही this earth, क्रान्ता is covered.

40009333.author: Translation
40009333.content: 'O Rama my wife has been usurped. There is the fear of his attack. So I am roaming this entire earth, covered with forests and oceans.

40009334.author: पदार्थः
40009334.content: भार्याहरणदुःखितः tormented by the abduction of my wife, कारणान्तरे for some other reason, वालिनः for Vali, दुराधर्षम् inaccessible, गिरिवरम् great mountain, ऋष्यमूकम् Rishyamuka, प्रविष्टः अस्मि I have come.

40009334.author: Translation
40009334.content: 'Tormented by the abduction of my wife by Vali, I came to the great Rishyamuka mountain  inaccessible to Vali for some other reason.

40009335.author: पदार्थः
40009335.content: राघव O Rama, एतत् this, महत् long, वैरानुकथनम् an account of the cause of our enmity, सर्वम् entirely, ते to you, आख्यातम् said, अनागसा for no fault, मया by me, प्रप्तम् befallen, व्यसनम् sorrow, पश्य see.

40009335.author: Translation
40009335.content: 'O Rama I have given you this long, full account of the cause of our enmity. For no fault of mine I am suffering.

40009336.author: पदार्थः
40009336.content: सर्वलोकभयङ्कर वीर warrior, who can frighten the entire world, वीर hero, वालिनः Vali, भयार्तस्य of the frightened, मे for me, प्रसादम् grace, तस्य his, निग्रहात् by resisting, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि you may.

40009336.author: Translation
40009336.content: 'O great warrior you are one who can frighten the entire world Due to the fear of Vali I seek your grace.You may resist Vali and provide me security.'

40009337.author: पदार्थः
40009337.content: एवम् that way, उक्तः spoken, धर्मज्ञः one who knows dharms, तेजस्वी glorious one, सः he, प्रहसन्निव as if joking with him, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, धर्मसंहितम् consistent with righteousness, वचनम् words, वक्तुम् to speak, आरेभे he started.

40009337.author: Translation
40009337.content: Having thus addressed by Sugriva the righteous and glorious Rama with a gentle smile  consistent with righteousness, started speaking:

40009338.author: पदार्थः
40009338.content: अमोघाः unfailing, सूर्यसङ्काशाः (bright) as the Sun, (रुषा अन्विता accompanied by anger), ममैते released by me, निशिताः sharp, मे शराः my arrows, दुर्वृत्ते on the evil doer, तस्मिन् वालिनि on that Vali, पतिष्यन्ति will descend.

40009338.author: Translation
40009338.content: 'These my sharp, unfailing arrows, bright as the Sun, released by me out of anger will descend on the evildoer, Vali.

40009339.author: पदार्थः
40009339.content: तव your, भार्यापहारिणम् abducter of your wife, तम् him, यावत् until, न not, अभिपश्यामि I do not see, तावत् till that time, पापात्मा sinner, चारित्रदूषकः violater of the moral code, सः वाली that Vali, जीवेत्  live.

40009339.author: Translation
40009339.content: 'That sinful Vali who has abducted your wife and violated the moral code will live only as long I do not see him.

40009340.author: पदार्थः
40009340.content: त्वाम् you, शोकसागरे in an ocean of sorrow, मग्नः immersed, आत्मानुमानात् due to my own sorrow, पश्यामि I see, त्वाम् you, अहम् I, तारयिष्यामि I will help you cross over, पुष्कलम् completely, कामम् desire, प्राप्स्यसि you will fulfil.

40009340.author: Translation
40009340.content: 'Inferring from my own experience, I see that you are immersed in an ocean of sorrow.I will help you cross over and fulfil your desire.'

40009341.author: पदार्थः
40009341.content: तस्य his, हर्षपौरुषवर्धनम् boosting his joy and vigour, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, परमप्रीतः very pleased, सुमहत् great, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40009341.author: Translation
40009341.content: On hearing his words that boosted his joy and vigour, Sugriva was immensely pleased and said these warm words. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे दशमस्सर्गः Thus ends the tenth sarga of Kishkindhakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
